non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: A Qwen checkpoint selected by clean held-out validation and an early-stop rule may complement the full-pool epoch-2 adapter differently. Compare both against the same fixed three-encoder family on the same capped clean SFT sample; use clean validation only for selection.
experiment_queue: Compare each existing encoder, the fixed-weight three-encoder family, and Qwen on the same new clean train_sft sample capped at 500 rows. Evaluate only fixed ensemble candidates supported by the initial suite.
If a multi-encoder combination improves clean validation accuracy, freeze its method and score it once on the full aggregate black-box test with Qwen and encoder baselines.

Then test seed and checkpoint diversity across existing Qwen SFT adapters, fixed prompt variants, and disagreement plus input-structure routing. Use disjoint clean validation partitions and source-disjoint BFCL holdouts where labels are available.
If the ensemble family plateaus, return to individual Qwen regularization and training-data hypotheses. Keep every aggregate test metric report-only.

After the current encoder fusion, routing, checkpoint-diversity, and individual Qwen hypotheses have been explored with clean-validation evidence, revisit the user-suggested few-shot prompting family. Compare a small hand-written example set with training-data example selection, and test retrieval only after the earlier branches are exhausted. Select examples and prompt variants with clean validation; keep test data aggregate-only and report-only.
last_action: The frozen three-encoder comparison completed with training provenance, clean validation, and aggregate test evidence recorded. Clean-validation selection remains the entropy gate. The full-pool Qwen reference checkpoint validation is now active; its early-stopped checkpoint comparison is queued next.

next_hypothesis: After the frozen multi-encoder test measurement, continue with the queued checkpoint diversity, prompt-only, disagreement, and visible-input routing hypotheses. Keep few-shot prompting deferred until those existing ensemble and individual-model ideas are exhausted.

post_queue_report_required.trigger: After the active frozen gate test and paired checkpoint clean-validation runs.
post_queue_report_required.contents: Report component training metrics as provenance, the 500-row clean-validation comparison, and aggregate black-box test metrics only as a report. State the validation-only checkpoint selection rule and disclose that test metrics did not select models.
post_queue_report_required.selection: Clean validation only; test labels and aggregate test metrics never select candidates.

future_policy.continuation_metric: Clean held-out validation accuracy when validation is available.
future_policy.stop_rule: Stop at the first epoch where clean held-out validation accuracy does not improve. If validation is omitted by explicit direction, follow its fixed schedule.
future_policy.reported_metrics: Training accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 deterministic random training examples; held-out validation accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 examples; aggregate black-box test accuracy and macro F1 from the full test set.
future_policy.test_metrics_use: Aggregate report only, never use test labels or per-example outcomes for selection.

open_ended_phase: Explore encoder plus strongest Qwen SFT fusion first. Compare fixed blends, confidence and disagreement gating, class routes, visible-input routes, and then a regularized validation-trained stacker if fixed fusion improves validation. If no ensemble helps clean validation, return to controlled individual Qwen training changes.

evidence_audit.training_metrics_scope: Inference-only ensemble evaluation. Training metrics are available in the records for the frozen Qwen and three encoder checkpoints.

duplicate_worker_failure.reason: Shared heartbeat.tmp collision while duplicate command targeted the same output directory. No checkpoint or evaluation was saved.

stopped_experiment.reason: User requested stopping the active run and clearing the queue before continuing ensemble exploration.

queue_cleared_reason: The user requested that the active experiment and pending queue be stopped and cleared before further exploration. The queue now contains only the clean-validation ensemble screen.

failed_experiment.failure: The clean SFT source rows do not expose question/tools keys. The visible-input router now derives those features from the constructed validation input text. No official test data was loaded.

selected_ensemble_candidate.rule: Take the fixed-weight raw-logit ensemble of the three encoders using weights 0.35625, 0.1375, and 0.50625. Convert it to probabilities, then select whichever has lower predictive entropy between that encoder-family distribution and Qwen probabilities.
selected_ensemble_candidate.selection: Clean validation only. Aggregate test comparison is report-only.

ensemble_candidate_history.selection: Clean validation only; test score report-only.
